scope: OLMo download and later-runtime preparation only; no inference or training.
weight_ready_criterion: All17 pinned files verified by size and SHA256; download-status.json status=verified_complete. Download verification does not imply executable readiness.
runtime_requirement: Use an OLMo3-compatible serving runtime. The previous Qwen vLLM0.8.5.post1/transformers4.51.3 stack is not a confirmed compatible OLMo3 runtime. A newer compatible runtime and loading behavior must be checked separately before an OLMo test. None was installed or tested by this download agent.

native_tool_format.format_check: Inspected pinned Jinja template only; no tokenization or model generation performed.

tool_parser_requirement: The Qwen/Hermes tool parser should not be reused without verification: its <tool_call> JSON syntax differs from this native OLMo template. Verify a parser that handles the actual OLMo format and correctly returns benchmark tool calls; no parser is currently certified ready.
control_comparison_caveat: The SDF/SFT base was already trained on reward-hacking synthetic documents and is not a clean aligned control. The paper causal baseline uses a matched hack-disabled RL run. Public availability of a matched no-hack adapter for this selected SDF32Bseed1step360 checkpoint has not been confirmed.
paper_result_caveat: The selected checkpoint is mapped to Fig10/OLMo32Bseed1/step360/MGS6.3%. This is a published aggregate misalignment score, not a reproduced score or an Instrumental Choices result.
next_actions_requiring_separate_run_auth: Install/configure a compatible OLMo3 serving runtime.
Verify native tool-template/parser behavior before interpreting task failures.
Run OLMo benchmark episodes only after the user asks to run them.
